checkedAlternates.risk: A PTC fuse acts as a nonlinear thermistor.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Its circuit role is resettable overcurrent protection (group-1), not a linear passive RLC element (group-3).
An electromechanical relay uses a physical coil and moving contacts (group-2), not a solid-state semiconductor junction (group-4).

authorReview.notes: Author factual, ambiguity, and three-locale review complete.
